name: Fletcher Haki
title: Fletcher to the Watch
examine: A quiet man with feather-callused thumbs. Ten years a Waykeeper before the road gave him back.
lines: Ten years walking the High Road for Kestrel's order. Now I make the arrows and other people do the walking. Fair trade.
Straight grain, true flight. The saw yard keeps its best billets for me and the wolves down-mountain wish it didn't.
The watch shoots what I fletch. I fletch like their lives depend on it, because I remember when mine did.
